svg.title: Free-Stuff-Near-You — Rounded $0 Local mark, v5
svg.desc: A more rounded upper-left body softens the ticket family while the right and bottom lobe contours, point rounding, and openings remain identical. The dollar is smaller and slightly greener than the zero. The right and bottom lobe segments are exact reflections across x equals y, with equal six-unit-radius openings at reflected positions. Original, unadopted concept with editable lettering.
